name: work-ops
description: Three skills for planning and executing work efficiently, no local hardware required: roadmap tracks Now/Next/Later initiatives in ROADMAP.md; grouping breaks an initiative or backlog into value-ranked groups and dispatches each to the cheapest sufficient Claude tier and effort level (Haiku/Sonnet/Opus, quick/standard/thorough); handoff checkpoints long-running batches so they survive context compaction or a closed session. Composes with local-llm-router's local-offload skill if you have it installed, but works fully standalone without it. The work-orchestration half of claude-efficiency-suite, split out for anyone who doesn't need local LLM routing.
